issues.symptom: Cova image shows different room entirely - appears to be a lounge/living room with sofa, while benchmark is a bedroom. Window treatment, ceiling fixture, wall dimensions completely different.
Cova renders eclectic/casual bohemian with orange sofa and string lights. Benchmark shows calm, minimalist scandinavian-modern aesthetic with neutral palette and tailored furnishings.
Cova sofa appears flat and lacking dimension. Cushions don't show realistic fabric draping. Benchmark bed has superior material photorealism and textural detail.
Cova composition sparse and unbalanced - large empty wall space, minimal layering. Benchmark uses thoughtful foreground (nightstand), mid (bed), background (artwork) distribution.
Cova lighting appears diffuse and flat with inconsistent window backlighting. Benchmark features cohesive warm overhead light with natural window fill and clear shadow definition.
Cova palette jarring - orange sofa against blue-grey walls creates tension. Benchmark's cream/beige/grey/natural wood palette is sophisticated and unified.
Cova shows soft edges and lacks detail refinement in furniture, decor, and textiles. Benchmark exhibits crisp details: pillow stitching, nightstand hardware, artwork framing, pampas grass definition.
Cova appears amateur with unrefined composition and styling choices. Benchmark is polished, magazine-ready interior design photograph.
Cova is generic lounge space unrelated to original brief. Benchmark thoughtfully adapts minimalist style to bedroom context with appropriate furnishings and scale.
Benchmark is substantially superior in every measurable dimension: photorealism, cohesion, editorial quality, and design coherence.
